phrases: Give first dose of artesunate or quinine for severe malaria
Give appropriate antibiotic treatment for an identified bacterial cause
If the tests are negative and the child has been breastfeeding, this does not rule out infection.
If more than one drug will be given, collect, count and package each drug
Give the first dose of artemether-lumefantrine in the clinic and observe for one hour.
Give paracetamol every 6 hours until high fever or ear pain is gone.
Continue using GV for 48 hours after the ulcers have been cured.
Give first dose any time after 6 months of age to ALL CHILDREN
IF REFERRAL IS NOT POSSIBLE OR DELAYED, repeat the ampicillin injection every 6 hours.
If convulsions have not stopped after 10 minutes repeat diazepam dose
Give full dose of oral antimlarial as soon as the child is able to take orally.
